messages:
maria: Hey team — need to shift our Wed 09:00 PST L1 deploy to Thu 02:00 UTC. Infra team opening a GPU maintenance window, we should move to avoid a partial outage. Who can own the deploy+traffic switch? :calendar:

sam: I can take the deploy if akiko is unavailable. Which services are in this train?

maria: Frontend, inference-router, and rollout-config service. Frontend is green. Inference-router has one pending CR (PR #8421) that needs a quick perf tweak. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/8421

akiko: I'm out Wed morning but back Thu. Sam — if you can wait for my quick perf change that's ideal, otherwise merge + hotfix after.

oliver: QA can own the smoke checks for inference-router. I can run the checklist and post results. Will need ~30m after deploy to complete the run.

ryan: Add me to the rollback plan. If latency p50 > 300ms or errors > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes, we rollback. I'll prep the rollback script and monitor dashboard.

jess: SRE note: I'll prewarm the dedicated pool at T-30m and disable autoscaler for that slot during the window. Also will set short-term alerts.

deploy-bot: Deploy window tentatively reserved: 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. Associated ticket: INF-1123. Please confirm owners. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks. Action items: Sam (deploy owner), Oliver (smoke), Ryan (rollback plan + monitor), Jess (prewarm). Sam — ping when PR merged. Akiko — pair if the perf tweak is needed.

sam: Merged PR #8421, CI passed. @akiko please quick sanity check when you're back. :thumbsup:

akiko: Quick look — LGTM, left two tiny comments that are non-blocking. :eyes:

oliver: Smoke run started after deploy: steps I ran:
1) `curl /health` across 3 regions
2) 500 inference requests using sample prompt set
3) check KV cache hit ratio and evictions
4) short load at 50 rps for 5m

oliver: Smoke results: all checks passed. latency p50=95ms, p95=280ms, error rate=0.0%. Marking smoke as PASS and tagging the release. ✔️

ryan: Rollback commands documented: `./scripts/rollback-inference-router.sh --to-tag v1.9.2` Exec steps: 1) block traffic via rollout-config, 2) run rollback script, 3) verify health checks. I'll be available for +30m post-deploy.

jess: Prewarm complete, autoscaler disabled for slot, monitoring alerts wired up (INF-RTR-LATENCY, INF-RTR-ERRORS). Ready to re-enable autoscaler after +30m if stable. :white_check_mark:

maria: Excellent coordination — thanks everyone. Closing the slot swap and noting owners in the release doc. :tada:
